description_en: 💎 Luxury 1+1 Apartment for sale + Parking Post 📍 Location: Park Gate - Elbasan Street, near the Artificial Lake. ✨ A unique property, positioned in one of the most elite areas of Tirana, between the greenery of the park and the tranquility of the Artificial Lake - ideal for luxury living or premium investment. 📐 Areas: • Total: 87.8 m². • Net: 73.6 m². 📄 Documentation: With Mortgage. 🏢 Floor: 7. ☀️ Orientation: South. 🌳 View: Panoramic from the park. 🚗 Parking: 1 parking spot is included. 🛋 Organization of the apartment: • Living room + modern kitchen. • Functional corridor. • Comfortable bedroom. • Contemporary toilets. 💎 Features: • Natural lighting throughout the day. • High construction standards. • Maximum security. • Exclusive lifestyle, just steps from the Artificial Lake. 💰 Price: €430,000.
